turns.question: At which hour of the day did the most checkout events happen between 20 September and 3 October 2026, and how many were there in that hour?
turns.answer: The semantic layer cannot answer this: it has no hour-of-day grain (time dimensions go down to the day only), so I cannot say which hour had the most checkouts. The closest metrics are checkout_sessions (site sessions with a checkout, per day) and customer_actions filtered to the checkout action type, both of which can be given by day for 20 September to 3 October 2026.
